 # ADR-0063 — Bootstrap plan: the self-hosting boundary and the fixed-point criterion
 
 **Status:** Proposed
-**Implemented:** partial — **BEAM** self-hosting (§4): Stage 0/1 equivalence-locked (ported lexer + the **full `Rian.Pratt` grammar**, no projection; `Rian.Fixpoint`, `examples/rian/selfhost_*.rian`; `test/rian/fixpoint_test.exs`, `parse_fixpoint_test.exs`), the surface→Core lowering **fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_core.rian` equals `Rian.Core.from_expr`/`from_pat` over the whole surface-reachable expression+pattern vocabulary; `core_fixpoint_test.exs`), the capability checker ported over the scalar/String/Vec/nominal slice (`selfhost_cap.rian` equals `Rian.Capability`; `cap_fixpoint_test.exs`), the exhaustiveness gate ported over the single-column nullary-constructor slice (`selfhost_exhaust.rian` agrees with Maranget `useful?/3`; `exhaust_fixpoint_test.exs`), the ECMAScript backend's expression emitter ported over the literal/unary/binary slice (`selfhost_js.rian` equals `Rian.JS` term-for-term; `js_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **Kotlin/JVM and ECMAScript backends fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_jvm.rian` = `Rian.JVM.compile`, `selfhost_js.rian` = `Rian.JS.compile` — whole-module emission incl. sum types + multi-clause pattern dispatch + case/tuples/lists; `jvm_module_fixpoint_test.exs`/`js_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **BEAM backend fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_beam.rian` — whole-module abstract forms with native multi-clause dispatch — compiles via `:compile.forms` and runs identically to `Rian.Beam`; `beam_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **Rust backend fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_rust.rian` — whole-module emission with `enum`s + match-over-param-tuple dispatch + capability-lowered signatures — equals `Rian.Lower.rust_program`; `rust_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), a slice of the real type checker ported (`selfhost_checker.rian` agrees with `Rian.Check.infer` on closed integer expressions; `checker_infer_fixpoint_test.exs`); the **capability checker** and the **exhaustiveness gate** are now fully self-hosted (`selfhost_cap.rian` reproduces the whole `Rian.Capability` rust-param matrix; `selfhost_exhaust.rian` reproduces the complete Maranget `Rian.Exhaustiveness.useful?`), Stage 2 near-complete (decl front-end IR-equals `Rian.Decl`); the **composed `build`** (verified lexer + decl parser + beam backend, cross-module, driven by `selfhost_compose_real_sum.rian`) now self-compiles each **whole stage source** — the lexer (`compose_lexer_fixpoint_test.exs`), the decl parser (`compose_decl_whole_fixpoint_test.exs`), and the beam backend (`compose_beam_whole_fixpoint_test.exs`) — **and the driver itself**: v1 compiles its own whole source into a v2 driver that builds + runs programs identically to v1 (`compose_driver_whole_fixpoint_test.exs` — *the build compiling the build*, incl. cross-module remote calls, tuple/atom abstract-form construction, struct field access (`maps:get`), and `@external` FFI bodies parsed-and-spliced per ADR-0068). Whole-file self-compile locks now cover the **whole compiler-module set** (lexer/decl/beam/driver) plus the `selfhost_cap`/`selfhost_core`/`selfhost_exhaust` stages (`compose_selfcompile_fixpoint_test.exs`, `compose_stage_whole_fixpoint_test.exs`). **The bootstrap fixed point `v1 == v2` is CLOSED for the Rian compiler** (`selfhost_v1_v2_fixpoint_test.exs`): gen0 (Elixir-host-compiled) compiles the four compiler sources → gen1; gen1 recompiles the same sources → gen2; gen1 == gen2 in canonical forms **and** in bit-identical `.beam` (under `:deterministic`). Honest scope: this is `v1==v2` **for the Rian compiler — self-COMPILING and now PARTIALLY self-CHECKING**, compared on forms (the canonical artifact). The two **structural gates are wired into the build loop** — `build` refuses a non-exhaustive sum dispatch (verified `SelfhostExhaust`, env from the program's `type` decls) and a BEAM-illegal `ref` parameter (verified `SelfhostCap.beam_legal`), both via `:erlang.error` (`compose_exhaust_gate_fixpoint_test.exs`). It is **not** a claim that `build` reproduces `Rian.Beam`'s bytecode — `Rian.Beam` additionally emits `-spec`/type attributes and runs Reach, so the host artifact is richer by design; **full** self-CHECKING (Rian.Check type inference also in the loop, the checker port still infer-only over 5/12 Core nodes) remains the next terminus. The marching boundary is **measured** (`Rian.SelfHost` → `docs/self-host-status.md`, `test/rian/self_host_status_test.exs`), FFI crutches are **counted+enforced** (`@selfhost_ffi` ledger, `self_host_ffi_test.exs`), and the two untested-fragility areas now have fixpoints with teeth (`checker_fixpoint_test.exs`, `string_emit_fixpoint_test.exs`). **Portable** self-hosting (compile-the-compiler to Rust/JS) is a *separate, further* terminus, gated on ADR-0047 breadth + the `Fn` Reach gap — not near.
